title: Relational contrast contraction v0: shared local chemistry + row-sum-matched null + direct graph-level second-order contraction

role.locked: final report only, after predictions are frozen

data.row_map: split_E index i -> official-train row rows_sorted[i]

ssl_encoder.scope: full official-train 10k rows, unlabelled masked atom+bond+junction SSL
ssl_encoder.disclosure: Not Fit8k-only.  The strict Fit8k SSL checkpoint (08e5f613...) used by the P3 / BondRW split-E runs is a remote artifact not present in this checkout; regenerating it costs ~0.45 A100-h.  All three arms of this round share this single in-repo checkpoint, so every contrast is unaffected; only the descriptive comparison against the historical Fit8k-SSL P3 reference is confounded by the init.

kernel.definition: K_R = sym(P); P = (I + D^-1 A_L)/2 on the physical-bond line graph; zero-degree rows one-hot
kernel.null: d = K_R @ 1; K_D = d d^T / sum(d); B = K_R - K_D; zero mass -> B = 0

model.t_layout: upper triangle (row-major, diagonal included) of the 16x16 matrix
model.t_scale_policy: one global scalar = RMS of T entries over the 7996 fit rows at the shared initial state; same buffer for both arms
model.p3_equal_init: replaced: fresh composer/z_proj/reader under a shared fork seed, with the three new reader blocks (sum_h2, struct, T) zero-initialised so both arms start at the same function and open from step 1
model.param_note: reader 256 x2 identical to P3/DCC-L so the strong local readout is not the bottleneck; composer 488->128->96 keeps the total under 500k (160 wide would be 506,449). Total is 1.3% below the DCC-L reference (494,193).

train.selection: strict < on monitor MAE, keep earliest
train.epochs_note: epochs chosen so that steps_per_epoch*epochs ~= the 47400 updates of the historical DCC-L 10k run; 47376 vs 47400 = -0.05%

arms.null: T = Z^T K_D Z (row sums and total mass exactly matched to K_R)
arms.dccl: reference: frozen DCC-L dual-channel model, organized_local=True, same init seed / SSL / recipe / rows

budget.measure: sum of wall-clock seconds of every GPU occupancy, including probe, prediction and failures

stop_before_gpu_if: T indistinguishable from the degree null on real molecules (median ||T_R - T_D||_F / ||T_R||_F < 0.05)
T is rank-1 dominated on real molecules (median top eigenvalue share of T_R > 0.90)
T is reconstructible from the pre-existing reader blocks by a linear map with mean R^2 > 0.90
timing probe projects * 1.15 above the 2.0 A100-h cap
